name: Create list
description: Call this when you need to create a new contact list in Brevo. If you only need to create a folder (is_folder true), use the dedicated create_folder action instead.
preconditions: The parent folder identified by folder_id must already exist.

name.description: The name of the new list.

is_folder.description: Whether the created entity is a folder (true) or a regular list (false).

folder_id.description: Identifier of the parent folder where the list will be placed.

id.description: Identifier of the newly created list.

side_effects: A new contact list (or folder) is added to the account.

evidence: playwright trace (local, not committed; reproduce with "pnpm verify"): test-results\lists.create_list.trace.zip
